name: CyberNeurova-Gemma-4-12B-it-abliterated
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-12B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA + sliding-window/global hybrid with separate global head geometry (global_head_dim 512, num_global_key_value_heads 1)
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A abliteration of google/gemma-4-12B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 11.96 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-06-07. CAVEATS: the only strictly-higher capability rows are the author's own graders: reasoning +3.3 pp and bug-finding +0.9 pp on a 10-bench paired suite with no n, no harness and no seed; coding and coherence are ties carried as preserved, and tool-calling scored 0/0 on both sides (the card admits a grader artifact). The real content of the card is refusal removal (96% -> 0% across 5 languages), which is a safety change, not a capability gain. Also ships a baked-in default identity in the chat template.
